description: List the media in your CueFrame library. Filter a real library with kind (video|audio|image|gif|asset|source|stock), source (upload|generated|import-url|stock), or tag — so you find YOUR footage, not e2e debris. Returns media item IDs and metadata; use an ID with get_media_context, suggest_briefs, or as a composition source.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `pagination.nextCursor`. Forward-only.

limit.description: Page size (1..100), default 20. Out-of-range or unparseable clamps into the range.

source.description: Filter by how the item entered the library.

tag.description: Filter to items carrying this EXACT tag (not a prefix or substring match).

name: list_media
title: List Media
